extra.final_summary: Fixed two data-quality issues: (1) misspelled island labels "Dram"→"Dream" and "Torgerson"→"Torgersen" (3 cells) normalized to allowed labels; (2) 2 exact duplicate penguin rows removed to prevent double-counting. bill_length_mm and species were clean. Result — average bill length (mm) for Adelie penguins by island: Biscoe = 37.25, Dream = 37.47, Torgersen = 39.21 (24 rows used).
